svg.title: Euclid's Elements book anatomy
svg.desc: Illustrated guide to the thirteen books, the proof method, and reading questions
svg.text: A path through 13 books: from premises to proof
Definitions and postulates → constructions → a system of results
Each proof builds on earlier results
I.1 · Construct an equilateral triangle with two circles
State definitions and postulates, then build new results from earlier ones.
The figure guides intuition; the chain of reasons supports the conclusion.
In the first construction, what looks obvious in the figure but is not stated in the postulates?
